summary: Toqua (TRDA, confirmed: Campspot legal name 'Tellico Reservoir Development Agency, a Tennessee Governmental Entity'). Operator page + booking page + Campspot record/policies + FB season + 2012 Wayback map + Esri/3DEP. 142 full-hookup RV sites, season March-November, Campspot with a weekend 2-night minimum. Lakefront KEPT (pads 12-24 m from shore, 1.4-1.6 m above summer pool). Rates not re-readable: nothing on sale until 2027 opens.
flags: OWNERSHIP confirmed TRDA (state, policy_ref none): tellicolakecampgrounds.com footer 'TRDA (c) 2026' and Campspot legalName 'Tellico Reservoir Development Agency, a Tennessee Governmental Entity d/b/a Toqua Campground'.

WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT. North-tip ring loop: outer pads 12-20 m from the riprap shore over open mown grass (35.566165,-84.191558; 35.566369,-84.191750); east point: outer pads 19-24 m over open grass (35.564046,-84.190286; 35.564410,-84.190510; 35.563890,-84.190110). Pads 249.2-249.4 m vs the 247.8 m (813 ft) summer pool = ~1.5 m above over a gentle bank (kayak test passes). Operator: 'premium lakefront RV sites' (24 Premium sold by the night on Campspot). Site numbers: only from TRDA's 2012 map via Wayback (stale) - east-point 114B, 115, 116, 117, 119, 121; the north ring loop postdates that map and its numbers were not readable (the current Campspot SVG carries none, and the engine lists no sites while closed).
FEES not re-read: Campspot sells nothing on any date tried (2026-11-26 to 2027-06-12); stored $62-82 (Campspot, read 2026-10-10) stands. State-owned, so never price-gated.
